_comment: Labels for addresses the agents here are allowed to pay. A label is a claim about WHO an address belongs to, so each one says how it is derived and from what public artefact — an allowlist that merely asserts 'this is agent #001' is worth nothing. agents/tools/dashboard.ts re-derives every entry on each run and refuses to publish a label that no longer matches. An address with no entry here is shown as an address; that is not an error, it is the honest rendering of a payee nobody has identified. `ours` says whether the address belongs to this project, and it is what decides the disclosure on an agent's page: 'both ends of this are ours' is a claim like any other, so it is true only when EVERY payee is verifiably ours. An unlabelled payee is not evidence of a stranger, but it is an absence of evidence that it is us — and the direction that must never be guessed is the flattering one.

payees.label: agent #001
payees.derivation: the pay-to-public-key address of the agent key named in agent #001's published manifest, x402/demo/kaspa-x402-grant.json

payees.label: the Warda demo vendor
payees.derivation: the pay-to-public-key address of covenant/deploy/demo-vendor.key, which is the address https://warda-demo-api.vercel.app quotes for /weather, /fact and /inference

payees.label: agent #005's own relay key
payees.derivation: the pay-to-public-key address of the agent key named in agent #005's published manifest. It is on the allowlist because x402 `exact` cannot take a covenant spend, so the grant pays this key and this key pays the vendor — see x402/RELAY.md.

payees.label: Warda Growth · Researcher
payees.derivation: the pay-to-public-key address of growth/keys/researcher.key, which is the address https://warda-growth.vercel.app quotes for /verify and the one payee in every growth batch grant's allowlist

payees.label: X reads (the Listener's seller)
payees.derivation: the pay-to-public-key address of growth/keys/xreads.key.pub, which growth/listener-payees.txt names as the only address agent #012's grant may ever pay
